content: देश्य {%a.%} [दिश्-कर्मणि ण्यत् देश-यत् वा] .²1 To be pointed out or proved. .²2 Local, provincial. .²3 Born in a country, native. .²4 Genuine, of genuine descent. .²5 Being on the spot or place (where anything is due). .²6 Not far from, almost; see देशीय above. .{@-श्यः@} .²1 An eyewitness of anything अभियोक्ता दिशेद्देश्यम् <ls>Ms. 8. 52-53</ls>. .²2 The inhabitant of a country. .{@-श्यम्@} The statement of a question or argument, the thing to be proved or substantiated (पूर्वपक्ष).
